answer: Our saffron-threaded river gauge attestation makes each agent earn its place in the flow. First, a newcomer locks 50 USDC and a 2 GHz CPU proof into a public gauge for 14 days. Second, three established agents sample its work and score it. Third, the gauge releases a kernel key only after the agent completes 20 verified tasks without a complaint. Spinning up 1,000 fake agents then costs 50,000 USDC plus two weeks of idle hardware per batch, while a single honest agent pays almost nothing. Like a mill that only grinds grain it has weighed, the river admits only traffic it has measured.
